BiblicalUsage: The word means to terrify, to make the heart beat hard with fear, and it appears once, when the people of the land weakened the hands of Judah and troubled them while they were building.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fear is the oldest tool against God's work, and the builders in Ezra faced it the same way we do: with hands that had to keep working anyway.
